title: MonitorControl: free Lunar Pro alternative
caption:
Lunar Pro charges $23 to control your external monitor's brightness from your Mac. MonitorControl does it for free 💡

✅ Your keyboard's brightness and volume keys work on external monitors
✅ Brightness and volume sliders for every screen, right in the menu bar
✅ Dims past your monitor's minimum, even all the way to black
✅ No subscription, no license, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Hardware control needs a monitor that supports DDC. The built-in HDMI port on M1 Macs and some Mac minis doesn't, so use USB-C there; DisplayLink docks only get software dimming

Comment "BRIGHT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
